text: We can’t confirm whether this asset is deforestation-free. The evidence is inconclusive because key satellite data sources (Hansen GFC, JRC GFC2020, and MGAP 2021) lack coverage for this asset. Without observations, we can’t rule out tree-cover loss or confirm its absence. The assessment doesn’t support any claim—positive or negative—about deforestation after the 2020 baseline. Further data or ground verification would be needed to determine compliance with regulations like EUDR.
